personalHint: These settings organize your Skills page. They do not change skill contents or permissions.
noPins: No shortcuts yet. Pin a category here or use the pin on a skill card.
pinHint: Pin categories or individual skills. Use the arrows to reorder them. Changes save immediately.
categoryHint: Create, rename or remove categories. Writing, Research and other defaults are editable too.
deleteHint: Remove this category, its assignments and shortcuts. The skills remain available in All.
nameHint: Enter at least one name. Other languages fall back to English.
assignmentHint: Choose categories for this skill. Changes apply across versions without altering its contents or permissions.
noPersonalCategories: No categories yet. Create one to organize skills.
uncertain: The last save has not been confirmed. Retry to check the same operation without submitting it twice.
confirmPending: Retry to confirm the previous save first.
invalidInput: Check for duplicate or missing names and the shortcut limit.
conflict: Your settings changed elsewhere. Review the latest settings and try again.
categoryMissing: This category is no longer available. Choose another category.
skillUnavailable: This skill version is unavailable. You can unpin it in shortcut settings.
unavailable: Could not load or save your skill settings. Please try again.
browseHint: Find a skill for your next task.
